aliases.name: IT Collection LLC
aliases.notes: Named within the Part 2 item 2 description on Ivanka Trump's 2017 new-entrant OGE Form 278e: 'Ivanka M. Trump Business Trust (IT Collection LLC, Holding Company in New York NY))'.

notes: Holding company (New York, NY) held within the Ivanka M. Trump Business Trust. Recorded as the registry counterparty for the Business Trust royalty-income line on Ivanka Trump's 2017 new-entrant 278 (cp_rel_0012) - the single 'Over $50,000,000' value disclosed on that filing and the forcing case for the `floor` value shape. The Ivanka M. Trump Business Trust itself is the intermediary holding structure and is not modeled as a separate cp_entity this pass (single-relationship modeling per the Fork B decision).
